articles.summary: Century Communities, Inc. (NYSE: CCS)—a top national homebuilder, industry leader in online home sales, and featured on America's Most Trustworthy Companies by Newsweek and U.S. News World Report's Best Companies to Work For—today announced that, as part of its long-term succession planning process, Jim Francescon has been promoted to President, effective January 1, 2027. Mr. Francescon currently serves as Executive Vice President, Corporate Operations. Dale Francescon will continue to serve as Executive Chairman and Rob Francescon, who currently serves as Chief Executive Officer and President, will continue to serve as Chief Executive Officer. As President, Mr. Francescon will oversee the Company's homebuilding operations, land, and related corporate functions and will help drive the Company's strategy and growth. "Today's announcement reflects the implementation of a succession plan that our Board, Rob, and I have been planning and executing over the past two years," said Dale
articles.title: Century Communities Announces Promotion of Jim Francescon to President
